description: Six stereo amplifiers, each opened by an envelope of its own that a gate starts, with the first five able to be added into the sixth

params.text: Sets how long that channel's envelope takes to rise, 1ms at the bottom of its travel to 1000 seconds at the top
Sets how long that channel's envelope takes to fall, 1ms at the bottom of its travel to 1000 seconds at the top
Sets that channel's output level, 0 to 1, after the envelope and the volume jack
Opens that channel's envelope while it is held down, in place of a gate at the jack
Adds that channel's output and envelope into channel 6's outputs, at three tenths of its level for the audio
Switches that channel's envelope between rising and falling straight through, and rising, holding at full while the gate is high, then falling

inputs.text: The left side of that channel's signal; with nothing patched to the right jack below it this one feeds both sides
The right side of that channel's signal
A rising edge through 2V starts that channel's envelope; in the AHR setting the envelope also holds at full level while this stays above 1V
Scales that channel's amplifier, 0V closing it and 10V leaving it open; with nothing patched the channel is at full

outputs.text: The gate or trigger for that channel, in whichever of the three shapes the menu is set to
The left side of that channel after the envelope, the volume jack and the level knob
The right side of that channel after the envelope, the volume jack and the level knob

notes: the sixth channel's Sum button does nothing. Its parameter is configured with the name Disabled and the summing loop only covers channels 1 to 5.
summing adds to channel 6 rather than replacing it, so channel 6 carries its own signal plus three tenths of each summed channel.
channel 6's envelope jack then carries whichever is larger, its own envelope or the summed one.
menu: Full Cycle Gate — holds the gate output high from the moment the gate arrives until the envelope has fallen away
End of Cycle Trigger — sends a 1ms trigger from the gate output when the envelope finishes
Start + End Triggers — sends a 1ms trigger from the gate output at the start of the gate and another when the envelope finishes

inputs.1:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the left jack of that channel.
inputs.2:
high above 2V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.3:
0 to 10V · one channel only

unpatched it reads full open; a negative voltage does nothing here.
